aviation_incidents.headline: 塞爾維亞空軍MiG-29戰機墜毀 飛行員罹難
aviation_incidents.summary: 塞爾維亞國防部表示，該國空軍與防空部隊一架MiG-29戰鬥機於2026年11月17日在貝爾格勒西北方的Stara Pazova附近墜毀，飛行員Goran Bulajić少校罹難。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Serbian Air Force MiG-29 crashes, killing pilot
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Serbia’s Ministry of Defense said a Serbian Air Force and Air Defense MiG-29 fighter crashed on November 17, 2026, near Stara Pazova, northwest of Belgrade, killing its pilot, Major Goran Bulajić.

aviation_incidents.headline: 英國航空787-10客機滑出滑行道受困草地、拉各斯航班取消
aviation_incidents.summary: 英國航空一架波音787-10夢幻客機17日上午在倫敦希斯洛機場滑行時衝出滑行道。該機執飛前往奈及利亞拉各斯的BA75航班，約上午10時30分由5號航站C衛星樓登機門後推，前往27L跑道途中錯過轉彎而受困。據航班追蹤資料，飛機於當地時間上午10時45分左右未能完成預定轉彎，以約5節（每小時9.3公里）的速度滑行時，前輪陷入泥地，停在27L跑道西端、5B與5C衛星樓之間的草地上，數小時後仍受困於原地。事故原因目前仍不明。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: British Airways Boeing 787-10 veers off taxiway at Heathrow, stuck in mud
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A British Airways Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner has suffered a taxiway excursion at London Heathrow Airport (LHR). The widebody twinjet had pushed back from its gate at the airport's satellite Terminal 5C and was on its way to runway 27L ahead of its planned departure to Murtala Muhammed International Airport (LOS) in Lagos, Nigeria, as BA75. However, it missed a turn and got stuck. Several hours later, the aircraft remained beached in the grass at the western end of runway 27L between satellite terminals 5B and 5C. British Airways has confirmed that it is working to get the passengers of flight BA75 on their way again, but the return leg has been canceled as a result of the excursion.

taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空宣佈，規劃在2027年3月23日開航臺北－雪梨－奧克蘭新航線。這將是星宇航空成立以來，首次將航網延伸至大洋洲。

international_aviation.headline: RTX旗下柯林斯航太在印度動工興建螺旋槳維修廠、2029年初啟用
international_aviation.summary: RTX旗下柯林斯航太已正式在印度動工興建一座新的螺旋槳維修廠。公司於2026年11月17日宣布，工程已在班加羅爾占地26英畝的柯林斯印度營運中心動土。新廠預計2029年初啟用，將專精於ATR42/72區域客機與空中巴士C295軍用運輸機的先進螺旋槳系統，服務整個亞太地區；柯林斯航太表示，這是印度首家獲外國航太原始設備製造商授權的螺旋槳維修廠。
international_aviation.headline_en: RTX's Collins Aerospace begins work on new propeller MRO facility in India
international_aviation.summary_en: RTX's Collins Aerospace has officially begun construction work on a new propeller maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) facility in India. On November 17, 2026, the company announced that the first spades were in the ground at the already established 26-acre Collins India Operations Center in Bengaluru. Scheduled to open in early 2029, the facility will specialize in advanced propeller systems for ATR 42/72 regional aircraft and Airbus C295 military transport platforms throughout the Asia Pacific region, and Collins Aerospace says it is the country's first propeller MRO facility authorized by a foreign aerospace original equipment manufacturer.
